title: CLASSIC UGANDA GORILLA & WILDLIFE SAFARI
highlights: Game drives in Murchison Falls & Queen Elizabeth NP
Boat cruise on the Nile and Kazinga Channel
accommodation: Mid-range: Pakuba Safari Lodge, Kibale Forest Camp, Ishasha Jungle Lodge
inclusions: Gorilla permit, park fees, meals, transport, guide.
description: Uganda, often referred to as the Pearl of Africa, offers one of the most thrilling and awe-inspiring safari experiences on the continent. The Classic Uganda Gorilla & Wildlife Safari is a once-in-a-lifetime journey that takes you from the lush tropical forests of Bwindi to the savannah plains of Queen Elizabeth National Park, combining close-up encounters with endangered mountain gorillas, tree-climbing lions, and a stunning diversity of landscapes and cultures.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Welcome to Uganda! Upon arrival at Entebbe International Airport, you'll be met by your guide and transferred to your hotel. Depending on your arrival time, you may have the opportunity to explore the charming town of Entebbe, visit the botanical gardens, or simply relax and prepare for your adventure.

itinerary.title: Entebbe to Murchison Falls National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Murchison Falls National Park, Uganda's largest protected area. En route, visit the Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary for a guided rhino tracking experience on foot. Continue to Murchison Falls, arriving in the late afternoon with time to settle into your lodge and enjoy the sunset over the Nile.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls National Park
itinerary.description: Begin with an early morning game drive on the northern bank of the Nile, where you'll search for elephants, lions, giraffes, and more. In the afternoon, take a boat cruise up the Nile to the base of Murchison Falls, offering excellent opportunities for wildlife photography and bird watching. The cruise ends with a hike to the top of the falls (optional) for spectacular views.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls to Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Depart Murchison Falls and journey south to Kibale Forest National Park, home to the highest concentration of primates in Africa. The scenic drive takes you through tea plantations and rural villages, offering glimpses of local life. Arrive at your accommodation in the late afternoon.

itinerary.title: Chimpanzee Tracking & Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: Morning chimpanzee tracking in Kibale Forest. Spend an hour observing these fascinating primates in their natural habitat. After lunch, transfer to Queen Elizabeth National Park, arriving in time for an evening game drive in the Ishasha sector, famous for its tree-climbing lions.

itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
itinerary.description: Morning game drive in Queen Elizabeth National Park, followed by a boat cruise on the Kazinga Channel, home to the highest concentration of hippos in Africa. In the afternoon, continue to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, home of the endangered mountain gorillas.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Early breakfast before your gorilla trekking experience. After a briefing at park headquarters, trek through the forest with experienced guides in search of a habituated gorilla family. Spend a magical hour with these gentle giants, observing their behavior and social interactions. Return to your lodge for a relaxing evening and to share your gorilla encounter stories.

itinerary.title: Bwindi to Lake Mburo & Departure
itinerary.description: Depart Bwindi and travel to Lake Mburo National Park for a game drive or boat safari. Continue to Entebbe, arriving in the evening for your onward flight or overnight stay (additional night not included in package).

reviews.name: Sarah Johnson
reviews.comment: The gorilla trekking experience was life-changing! Our guide was knowledgeable and made sure we had the best possible experience. Accommodations were comfortable and the food was excellent. Highly recommend this tour!

reviews.name: Michael Chen
reviews.comment: Great itinerary that showcases the best of Uganda. The gorillas were amazing and the game drives productive. Only suggestion would be more time in Queen Elizabeth National Park.

reviews.name: Emma Williams
reviews.comment: From start to finish, this safari exceeded our expectations. The diversity of wildlife we saw was incredible, and the gorilla encounter was the highlight of our lives. The guides were professional and accommodations were perfect.

title: RWANDA-UGANDA GORILLA DOUBLE TREK
highlights: Gorilla trekking in Rwanda and Uganda
Golden Monkey tracking in Volcanoes NP
Scenic drive through the Virunga Mountains
accommodation: Luxury: Bisate Lodge (Rwanda), Clouds Mountain Gorilla Lodge (Uganda)
inclusions: Private transfers, both gorilla permits, champagne sundowners.
description: Explore the Land of a Thousand Hills with this luxury gorilla trekking safari in Rwanda. Encounter mountain gorillas in the misty slopes of Volcanoes National Park, enjoy the hospitality of world-class lodges, and experience Rwanda's rich culture and natural beauty.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kigali International Airport where you'll be warmly welcomed by your guide. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy a Kigali city tour, including a visit to the Kigali Genocide Memorial, local markets, or art galleries. Transfer to your hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kigali to Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive through Rwanda’s scenic countryside to Volcanoes National Park in the northwest. En route, stop at local artisan shops or community cooperatives. Arrive at your luxury lodge nestled in the Virunga highlands with time to relax and enjoy the breathtaking views.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.description: An early start takes you to the park headquarters for a briefing before your gorilla trek. Trek through the forested slopes in search of a habituated mountain gorilla family. Spend an awe-inspiring hour with them before returning to the lodge for relaxation or a guided village walk.

itinerary.title: Optional Activities or Golden Monkey Trek
itinerary.description: Choose an optional golden monkey trek, visit the Dian Fossey Tomb, or enjoy a community visit and cultural performance. Alternatively, relax at the lodge or hike to nearby volcanic viewpoints. The day is flexible and tailored to your preferences.

itinerary.title: Return to Kigali & Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer back to Kigali. Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy some last-minute shopping or sightseeing before being dropped off at the airport for your departure.

reviews.name: Sarah Johnson
reviews.comment: The gorilla trekking experience was life-changing! Our guide was knowledgeable and made sure we had the best possible experience. Accommodations were comfortable and the food was excellent. Highly recommend this tour!

reviews.name: Michael Chen

reviews.name: Emma Williams

accommodation: Luxury: Chobe Safari Lodge, Kyangabi Crater Lake Resort
inclusions: Domestic flights, exclusive guides, gourmet dining.
description: Discover the heart of Uganda with this luxury safari adventure. Encounter rhinos at Ziwa, cruise beneath the powerful Murchison Falls, track chimps in Kibale, explore the wildlife of Queen Elizabeth, and meet mountain gorillas in Bwindi. End with a serene retreat at Lake Bunyonyi.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Arrive at Entebbe International Airport. Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy a city tour of Entebbe including the Botanical Gardens or Uganda Wildlife Education Centre.

itinerary.title: Entebbe to Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive north to Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary. Enjoy a guided walking safari to track white rhinos. Continue toward Murchison Falls National Park with an evening at leisure.
itinerary.accommodation: Amuka Lodge or Pakuba Safari Lodge

itinerary.title: Explore Murchison Falls
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a game drive in Murchison Falls National Park. In the afternoon, take a boat safari to the base of the falls. Optional: Helicopter tour over the mighty falls.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls to Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Depart for Kibale via scenic countryside. This long but rewarding drive offers beautiful views of Albertine Rift landscapes. Arrive and settle in near the forest.

itinerary.title: Chimpanzee Habituation Experience
itinerary.description: Embark on a full-day chimpanzee habituation experience in Kibale Forest. Spend extended time with a chimpanzee group as they go about their daily routines.

itinerary.title: Kibale to Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Queen Elizabeth National Park. Optional crater lake visits en route. Enjoy an evening game drive spotting lions, elephants, and buffalo.
itinerary.accommodation: Kyambura Gorge Lodge or Kyangabi Crater Lake Resort

itinerary.title: Game Drives & Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Morning game drive in Kasenyi plains. In the afternoon, enjoy a boat safari along the Kazinga Channel—famous for its hippo and bird populations.

itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
itinerary.description: Drive to Bwindi through the Ishasha sector, known for tree-climbing lions. Arrive in Bwindi for rest and briefing in preparation for gorilla trekking.
itinerary.accommodation: Sanctuary Gorilla Forest Camp or Mahogany Springs

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Begin early with a briefing from rangers before heading into the dense forest for a once-in-a-lifetime gorilla trekking experience. Spend up to an hour with a gorilla family.

itinerary.title: Bwindi to Lake Bunyonyi & Return to Entebbe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Lake Bunyonyi for a relaxing boat ride or sunset cruise. Optional: Local market visit. Then fly back to Entebbe for your international departure.

title: RWANDA-UGANDA GORILLA DOUBLE TREK.
highlights: Gorilla trekking in Rwanda and Uganda
Golden Monkey tracking in Volcanoes NP
Scenic drive through the Virunga Mountains
accommodation: Luxury: Bisate Lodge (Rwanda), Clouds Mountain Gorilla Lodge (Uganda)
inclusions: Private transfers, both gorilla permits, champagne sundowners.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey across Rwanda and Uganda in search of the majestic mountain gorillas. Trek through mist-covered forests, experience golden monkey encounters, and enjoy the comforts of world-class eco-lodges nestled in Africa’s most iconic mountain ranges.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.description: Arrive in Kigali, Rwanda's vibrant capital. Your guide will greet you and take you on a brief city tour including the Kigali Genocide Memorial and local cultural centers. Later, relax at your luxurious hotel.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scenic drive to Volcanoes National Park through lush hills and villages. En route, stop by artisan markets or coffee cooperatives before checking in at your forest lodge with views of the Virunga peaks.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Rwanda
itinerary.description: After an early briefing at park headquarters, begin your trek into the forest in search of mountain gorillas. Spend a powerful hour in their presence before returning for a gourmet lunch and afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Golden Monkey Trek & Cross to Bwindi (Uganda)
itinerary.description: In the morning, enjoy a golden monkey trek or visit the Dian Fossey site. Then transfer across the Cyanika border into Uganda’s Bwindi Impenetrable Forest. Settle into your luxury lodge amidst the jungle.
itinerary.accommodation: Clouds Mountain Gorilla Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Venture into Uganda’s side of the forest for another thrilling gorilla trek. Each trek offers a unique experience and group. Afterward, relax with a massage or enjoy the views from the lodge.

itinerary.title: Depart via Kigali
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Kigali through the rolling hills and border towns. Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy lunch or some final shopping before airport drop-off.

reviews.name: Liam Nkwanzi
reviews.comment: I’ve done safaris before, but nothing compares to seeing gorillas in both Rwanda and Uganda. Every detail was taken care of, and the experience felt truly personal. Volcanoes and Bwindi are both stunning.

reviews.name: Anika Patel
reviews.comment: Loved the golden monkeys and the scenic drive between the two countries. The Uganda trek was more challenging, but also more rewarding. Only wish we had an extra day to unwind at the lodge.

reviews.name: James Holloway
reviews.comment: A perfect blend of luxury, adventure, and culture. From the attentive guides to the gourmet meals, every part of the trip was flawless. I’ll remember those gorilla moments for the rest of my life.

reviews.name: Nina Russell
reviews.comment: The helicopter flight over Murchison Falls was absolutely breathtaking! Every day felt like a new adventure. Our guide was incredible and the chimpanzee trek was a big surprise highlight.

reviews.name: Kevin Obote
reviews.comment: Top-notch safari with impeccable logistics. I would have preferred an extra day at Lake Bunyonyi to just soak it in, but otherwise everything was smooth and luxurious.

reviews.name: Monica Rojas
reviews.comment: Every lodge had its own charm, the food was amazing, and I truly felt spoiled the whole way through. Watching gorillas in Bwindi was surreal. Worth every penny.

title: PRIMATE PARADISE: CHIMPS & GORILLAS
description: This primate-focused safari takes you deep into Uganda's tropical forests to meet our closest relatives — chimpanzees and mountain gorillas. From lush Kibale to misty Bwindi, you’ll track endangered species, explore diverse ecosystems, and spot wildlife on savannah plains in comfort and style.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Arrive at Entebbe International Airport. Your guide will meet you and transfer you to your hotel. Depending on arrival time, you may explore the botanical gardens or relax by Lake Victoria.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Travel west through scenic countryside to Kibale National Park, home to the highest concentration of primates in Africa. Enjoy an evening nature walk or relax at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Chimpanzee Tracking in Kibale
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a guided chimpanzee tracking experience in the lush Kibale Forest. In the afternoon, visit Bigodi Wetlands for birdwatching and a cultural community walk.

itinerary.title: Kibale to Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Queen Elizabeth National Park. Stop at crater lakes en route. Later, enjoy a game drive in the Kasenyi plains and spot elephants, lions, and antelopes.

itinerary.title: Game Drive & Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Take a morning game drive followed by a relaxing boat cruise along the Kazinga Channel. Look out for hippos, crocodiles, and numerous bird species.

itinerary.title: Drive to Bwindi via Ishasha
itinerary.description: Journey through the Ishasha sector, famous for its tree-climbing lions. Continue to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Rest and prepare for gorilla tracking.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking & Departure
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, head to the park headquarters for a briefing before your gorilla trek. Spend time observing a gorilla family. Later, drive back to Entebbe or connect to your outbound flight.

reviews.name: Rachel Kimani
reviews.comment: Chimp tracking was unforgettable! The guide knew every sound in the forest. We loved the balance between nature, wildlife, and cultural experiences.

reviews.name: Tomás Oliveira
reviews.comment: A very well-planned trip with great value for mid-range travelers. Gorilla trekking is worth every bit of the effort. Accommodations were cozy and surrounded by nature.

reviews.name: Linda Mbabazi
reviews.comment: This was a birthday trip for me and it blew me away! Seeing both chimps and gorillas in the wild was surreal. I loved the slower pace and the local hospitality.

title: RWANDA TO UGANDA EXPLORER
highlights: Game drives in Akagera and Queen Elizabeth
accommodation: Mid-range: Ruzizi Tented Lodge, Buffalo Safari Lodge
description: This unique itinerary connects Rwanda and Uganda in one thrilling journey. Begin with savannah safaris in Akagera, then cross into Uganda for wildlife sightings in Queen Elizabeth and unforgettable gorilla trekking in Bwindi. The perfect blend of East Africa's big game and primate encounters.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kigali International Airport where you'll be greeted by your guide. Enjoy a city tour based on your arrival time, including the Genocide Memorial, Inema Art Center, or local markets.

itinerary.title: Kigali to Akagera National Park
itinerary.description: Drive east to Akagera National Park, Rwanda’s only savannah park. Check in and go on your first afternoon game drive, looking for giraffes, zebras, and elephants.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive & Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Enjoy a sunrise game drive across Akagera’s diverse terrain. After lunch, take a boat safari on Lake Ihema to spot hippos, crocodiles, and rare birds.

itinerary.title: Cross to Uganda – Lake Mburo NP
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer through the border into Uganda. Arrive at Lake Mburo National Park and enjoy a short walking safari or evening game drive.

itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Bwindi Forest
itinerary.description: Depart Lake Mburo for Bwindi, home of the endangered mountain gorillas. Enjoy scenic views of banana plantations and terraced hills along the way.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: After an early morning briefing, set out into the misty rainforest to track and spend time with a gorilla family. The trek can be challenging, but the reward is unforgettable.

itinerary.title: Bwindi to Queen Elizabeth NP (Ishasha)
itinerary.description: Travel north to Queen Elizabeth National Park through the Ishasha sector, famous for tree-climbing lions. Enjoy an afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Game Drive & Boat Safari on Kazinga Channel
itinerary.description: Early game drive in the Kasenyi plains. Later, cruise the Kazinga Channel, one of Africa’s densest hippo and bird habitats.

itinerary.title: Return to Entebbe & Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer back to Entebbe by road (or optional flight). Depending on your schedule, visit craft shops before heading to the airport.

reviews.name: Asha Mwangi
reviews.comment: Crossing from Rwanda to Uganda on safari was seamless and exciting! Akagera was beautiful, and the gorilla trek in Bwindi was worth every step. Great value for a mid-range tour.

reviews.name: Jared Thompson
reviews.comment: This itinerary lets you experience the best of both worlds. I especially enjoyed the boat rides and the surprise lion sighting in Ishasha!

reviews.name: Caroline Tusiime
reviews.comment: From Kigali's charm to Uganda's wildlife, everything ran smoothly. The guides were knowledgeable and fun. I would recommend this to any nature-loving traveler!

title: ULTIMATE GREAT LAKES ADVENTURE
highlights: White-water rafting at the Nile Source
accommodation: Luxury: Apoka Safari Lodge, Sanctuary Gorilla Forest Camp
description: Journey through Uganda’s most iconic regions in unmatched luxury. From the roaring Nile in Jinja to the remote savannahs of Kidepo, the thunderous Murchison Falls, and the primate-rich rainforests of Kibale and Bwindi, this adventure is the ultimate fusion of adrenaline, culture, and natural wonder.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Arrive in Entebbe and enjoy a relaxed evening at the lakeside. Optional sunset cruise or city tour depending on your arrival time.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Jinja – Nile Source & Rafting
itinerary.description: Drive to Jinja, East Africa’s adventure capital. In the afternoon, go white-water rafting on the Nile or enjoy a gentler sunset boat ride to the Nile source.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kidepo Valley NP
itinerary.description: Board a private charter flight to Kidepo, Uganda’s most remote park. Upon arrival, take a sunset game drive across the vast savannahs of the Karamoja region.

itinerary.title: Explore Kidepo & Cultural Visit
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Kidepo’s valleys teeming with lions, giraffes, buffalo, and ostriches. Visit a nearby Karamojong village for an immersive cultural experience.

itinerary.title: Fly to Murchison Falls
itinerary.description: Take a scenic flight to Murchison Falls National Park. Enjoy a boat safari on the Nile and witness the explosive waterfalls up close.
itinerary.accommodation: Bakers Lodge or Nile Safari Lodge

itinerary.title: Game Drives in Murchison
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive on the northern bank of the park, tracking lions, giraffes, elephants, and hyenas. Optional: Helicopter flight over the falls.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Fly or drive southwest through the Albertine Rift to Kibale Forest National Park. Enjoy views of crater lakes and rich tea plantations.

itinerary.title: Chimpanzee Habituation Experience
itinerary.description: Join a research team in Kibale for a full-day chimpanzee habituation experience. Observe the chimps from nest to nesting in their natural habitat.

itinerary.title: Drive to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
itinerary.description: Travel south to Bwindi through beautiful countryside. Arrive and relax at your lodge, perched on the forest edge.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Begin early with a briefing from park rangers, then trek into the forest to meet a mountain gorilla family. Spend a magical hour with them before hiking back.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Lake Bunyonyi – Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Lake Bunyonyi, Uganda’s most scenic lake. Take a sunset canoe ride among the misty islands and enjoy local storytelling.
itinerary.accommodation: Birdnest @ Bunyonyi Resort or Arcadia Lodge

itinerary.title: Fly to Entebbe & Departure
itinerary.description: Take a domestic flight from Kihihi or Kisoro to Entebbe. Depending on your departure time, enjoy craft shopping or a lakeside lunch before your flight.

reviews.name: Jill Robertson
reviews.comment: An absolute dream from start to finish! From rafting the Nile to the remote Kidepo plains and finally standing feet away from gorillas — this is the best trip I’ve ever done.

reviews.name: Samuel Atwine
reviews.comment: A well-curated experience with luxury and adventure blended seamlessly. The private flights made it all so smooth and efficient.

reviews.name: Angela Chow
reviews.comment: I loved the diversity — every park and region had something unique. The accommodations were stunning. I just wish we had one more night at Lake Bunyonyi!

title: FAMILY-FRIENDLY UGANDA SAFARI
accommodation: Mid-range: Sambiya River Lodge, Mihingo Lodge
description: Designed with families in mind, this Ugandan safari offers wildlife encounters, nature-based play, and unforgettable moments. Track rhinos on foot, meet chimpanzees in Kibale, and ride horses alongside zebras in Lake Mburo. It's the perfect combination of adventure and bonding.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Land at Entebbe International Airport where your guide will greet you. Transfer to your family-friendly hotel and unwind from your flight. Optional: visit the reptile village or zoo for young explorers.

itinerary.title: Entebbe to Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Drive to Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary. Go on a short guided rhino walk, suitable for all ages. After lunch, continue to Murchison Falls National Park and settle in at your lodge.

itinerary.title: Murchison Falls Game Drive & Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Enjoy a morning game drive where kids can help spot elephants, giraffes, and buffalo. After lunch, take a calm boat safari to the base of the falls.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kibale Forest
itinerary.description: Travel south to Kibale, passing tea plantations and crater lakes. Make short stops along the way to stretch and explore.

itinerary.title: Family Chimpanzee Walk & Nature Crafts
itinerary.description: Take part in a family-friendly forest walk to look for chimpanzees (shorter and slower-paced). In the afternoon, enjoy a local storytelling session or nature-based crafts for children.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Lake Mburo National Park
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Mburo. Take a relaxed game drive spotting zebras, impalas, and warthogs. Optional: evening storytelling around the fire or short bush walk.

itinerary.title: Horseback Riding & Relaxation
itinerary.description: Go on a gentle horseback safari (available for kids). Relax by the infinity pool overlooking the park or take a nature scavenger hunt.

itinerary.title: Return to Entebbe & Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Entebbe. Optional stop at the equator line for photos and snacks. Drop-off at the airport for your flight home.

reviews.name: Grace & Daniel Mbogo
reviews.comment: Traveling with two young kids, we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The guides were patient, and the activities kept everyone happy. We loved the rhinos and horse rides!

reviews.name: Claire Henderson
reviews.comment: Great trip for active families! Our daughter enjoyed seeing baby chimps and roasting marshmallows by the fire at Lake Mburo. Would recommend an extra day at Mihingo Lodge if time allows.

reviews.name: Nadia Akello
reviews.comment: Everything was smooth and safe. Our 8-year-old even started keeping a safari journal thanks to the ranger’s encouragement. Wonderful bonding trip!

title: RWANDA-UGANDA HONEYMOON SPECIAL
highlights: Romantic lakeside dinners at Lake Kivu
accommodation: Luxury: One&Only Gorilla's Nest, BirdNest Resort
description: Designed for adventurous couples, this luxurious honeymoon blends nature, romance, and unforgettable experiences. Trek mountain gorillas in Bwindi, sip champagne by Lake Kivu, and drift across Lake Bunyonyi's serene waters. A perfect beginning to your lifelong journey together.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kigali International Airport where you're welcomed with flowers and champagne. Enjoy a romantic city tour, including a private visit to Inema Art Center or a scenic rooftop dinner.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.description: Take a scenic drive to Volcanoes National Park. Check into your luxury forest lodge and enjoy a couple's massage or candlelit dinner overlooking the Virunga Mountains.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Volcanoes NP
itinerary.description: Begin early for your gorilla trek. Hike into the forest and spend a magical hour with a gorilla family. Return to the lodge for a private picnic lunch and evening relaxation.

itinerary.title: Leisure at Lake Kivu
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Kivu for two nights of bliss. Enjoy a lakeside lunch, couples' kayak session, and a private sundowner on a boat.

itinerary.title: Cross into Uganda – Transfer to Bwindi
itinerary.description: After a late breakfast, take a scenic route through the hills to cross into Uganda. Arrive in Bwindi and settle into your forest hideaway with sunset drinks by the fire.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Start early for your second gorilla trek — each encounter is different. Celebrate the experience with a couples' portrait and dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lake Bunyonyi
itinerary.description: Head to Lake Bunyonyi, known for its romantic setting. Enjoy a leisurely canoe ride, island visit, and a floating lunch for two.

itinerary.title: Relaxation at Lake Bunyonyi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day to relax with optional activities: spa treatment, hiking, or guided community visit. End the day with a private lakeside dinner.

itinerary.title: Return to Kigali
itinerary.description: Transfer back to Kigali through Katuna border. Stop for scenic photos and lunch en route. Arrive in Kigali for your final night or evening flight.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kigali
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a last stroll or local gift shopping before your airport drop-off. End your honeymoon with memories to last a lifetime.

reviews.name: Nora & Ethan Blake
reviews.comment: This honeymoon was beyond magical. The lodges were dreamy, the gorilla experiences were surreal, and the candlelit dinners made us feel like royalty!

reviews.name: Léa and Hugo
reviews.comment: Every detail was perfect — from flower petals on the bed to the stunning canoe ride on Bunyonyi. We can’t wait to come back for an anniversary!

reviews.name: Sandra Kimani
reviews.comment: Perfect for couples who love nature with a romantic twist. Would have loved an extra spa day, but overall it was the most unforgettable trip we’ve taken together.

title: UGANDA BIRDING & WILDLIFE EXTRAVAGANZA
highlights: Birding boat cruise in Queen Elizabeth
Guided forest walks in Bwindi and Gorilla tracking
accommodation: Mid-range: Mweya Safari Lodge, Gorilla Valley Lodge
description: A haven for nature enthusiasts and avid birders, this Uganda safari is designed to showcase the country’s avian diversity and iconic wildlife. Spot shoebills in Mabamba, track gorillas in Bwindi, cruise the Kazinga Channel, and identify hundreds of bird species along the way.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.description: Arrive at Entebbe International Airport. Transfer to your lodge near Lake Victoria. If time permits, enjoy an evening bird walk in the botanical gardens.

itinerary.title: Birding at Mabamba Wetlands
itinerary.description: Early morning canoe ride through Mabamba Swamp in search of the elusive shoebill stork and other wetland birds. Afternoon at leisure or optional sunset boat ride on Lake Victoria.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.description: Drive west through lush countryside to Queen Elizabeth National Park, birding en route. Arrive in time for an evening game and bird drive in the Kasenyi Plains.

itinerary.title: Kazinga Channel Birding Cruise
itinerary.description: Morning game drive followed by a boat safari along the Kazinga Channel — expect to see kingfishers, African fish eagles, pelicans, and more. Great opportunity for wildlife photography.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bwindi via Ishasha
itinerary.description: Bird your way south through the Ishasha sector, where you might spot tree-climbing lions. Stop for savannah and forest-edge birding on your way to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest.

itinerary.title: Birding in Bwindi Forest
itinerary.description: Explore Bwindi's diverse avifauna including the African green broadbill, Grauer’s rush warbler, and many Albertine Rift endemics. Optional nature walk or community experience in the evening.

itinerary.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi
itinerary.description: Join park rangers for a life-changing mountain gorilla trekking experience. Afterward, relax at your lodge or enjoy short bird walks around the forest edge.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Lake Mburo National Park
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Mburo, one of Uganda’s best birding parks. Spot acacia-dwelling species like the crested barbet and red-faced barbet.

itinerary.title: Bird Walks & Game Viewing in Lake Mburo
itinerary.description: Enjoy a guided bird walk and optional horseback safari. Look out for papyrus gonolek, black-collared barbets, and African finfoots. Perfect for winding down your adventure.

itinerary.title: Return to Entebbe & Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Entebbe, stopping at the equator for photos and last-minute bird sightings. Transfer to the airport for departure.

reviews.name: Bernard Mugisha
reviews.comment: I’ve been birding for years, and this trip was a dream come true. Over 300 species recorded, including the shoebill! Our guide had eagle eyes.

reviews.name: Leona Wood
reviews.comment: The boat cruise on Kazinga Channel was incredible — so many birds and hippos! Bwindi was also a highlight, both for the gorillas and forest species.

reviews.name: Adnan Yusuf
reviews.comment: Great itinerary with knowledgeable guides. We appreciated the slower pace for birding and photography. Would love to stay longer at Lake Mburo next time.
